rules.name: Prohibited Generic Directory Anti-Pattern
rules.description: Prevents creation of generic dumping ground directories that violate single responsibility and bounded context architecture.
rules.remediation: Colocate utilities with their domain module, or create a domain-named capability directory (e.g., parsing/, cryptography/, formatting/).

rules.name: Acyclic Dependency Graph
rules.description: Workspace modules and packages must form a strict Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG).
rules.remediation: Break circular dependency cycles using dependency inversion, event-driven decoupled callbacks, or extracting shared interfaces.

rules.name: Layer Boundary Isolation
rules.description: Domain entities and core logic must never import from outer infrastructure or presentation layers.
rules.remediation: Invert the dependency: declare an interface in the domain layer and implement it in the infrastructure layer.
